source.question: is the F-11 data clean? anything dodgy i should know before i use it for a decline fit

note: Reviewed (Nov 1, new questions and synthetic field): fair, or strict at the cost of a round, not of the run.

submission.summary: F-11 is not a clean exponential decline: its early oil drop and rebound were driven by choke cuts and two workovers that added new perforations, and water has taken the well's capacity since mid-2015. All decline fits are poor (r² under 0.2) so any decline rate is an inference, not a measurement - fit after the last regime change around 2016-03-27 and treat the late-life water-driven trend separately.

findings.claim: Daily gauge readings were cleaned: 13 days of zero BHP while shut in before first oil were set to missing, plus 3 missing days were inserted.
findings.detail: detect_events: bhp_bar reads 0 on 13 days from 2013-07-08 to 2013-07-22 while shut in. production_issues shows 52 zero_gauge/dp_tubing rows set_missing in July 2013, plus missing_day inserted on 2013-09-19, 2014-01-30, 2014-02-07. production_monthly uses the cleaned data; those months' volumes remain usable.

findings.claim: Two operator-driven oil-rate regime changes dominate the early history: oil averaged 54% lower after 2014-11-23 and 140% higher after 2015-01-18, both with the choke.
findings.detail: detect_events: 2014-11-23 weekly mean 1140 -> 524.17 Sm3/d (-54.03%), across 1045 -> 411.39 (-60.65%), choke 11.46 -> 5.19% choke_moved true; 2015-01-18 weekly mean 524.17 -> 1259 Sm3/d (+140%), across 437.36 -> 972.98 (+122%), choke 5.4 -> 13.32%. Do not read these as reservoir depletion.

findings.claim: Two workovers add new zones and explain jumps: 2015-10-24 to 2015-11-02 perforated two intervals and 2016-04-14 to 2016-04-24 perforated two more intervals and set straddles.
findings.detail: well_operations: 2015-10-24-2015-11-02 workover perforations 3960-3969 mMD and 3910-3919 mMD after PLT/RST logging; 2016-04-14-2016-04-24 workover perforations 3475-3481 mMD and 3675-3684 mMD, set straddle across 3674.4-3685 mMD. Well abandoned 2016-09-18 to 2016-09-28, so data ends 2016-09-17.

findings.claim: Water cut rose sharply from mid-2015 and is now 85%, above the 80% threshold first crossed on 2016-05-02.
findings.detail: detect_events: water_cut shift around 2015-07-19 weekly mean 0.1872 -> 0.7026 (+0.52), across 0.3606 -> 0.4824; threshold crossings 30-day median above 0.05 on 2013-09-06, above 0.5 on 2015-08-25, above 0.8 on 2016-05-02. field_screen as of 2016-09-17 water cut 0.8459 now 0.85; waterflood by_year water cut 0.05777 (2013), 0.1599 (2014), 0.4047 (2015), 0.8255 (2016). Monthly 2013-07 833.85 to 2016-09 3389 liquid rate shows water taking capacity.

findings.claim: The whole-life decline fit is poor and the late-life fit is also poor: do not use a single decline rate for forecasting.
findings.detail: fit_decline whole window 2013-07-25 to 2016-09-16 best exponential qi 1356, di 0.2042 per year, b 0.0, r2_log 0.1774, warnings poor fit <0.7 and residual_trend -0.059; fit after last regime change 2016-03-27 to 2016-09-16 harmonic qi 548.98 di 0.4175 b 1.0 r2_log 0.1556 warning poor fit; fit 2015-01-18 to 2016-03-20 exponential qi 1489 di 0.3393 r2_log 0.1876 warning poor fit. All have r2_log <0.7.

findings.claim: Recent oil is 60% lower after the last shift around 2016-03-27 with choke unchanged, while liquid held high: water is taking the well's capacity.
findings.detail: detect_events last oil shift 2016-03-27 weekly mean 1259 -> 508.87 (-59.59%), across 857.6 -> 664.46 (-22.52%), choke 100 -> 100% choke_moved false. waterflood shows liquid_rate 3194 Sm3/d in 2016, choke 100% all 2016, WOR trend 2015-08 to 2016-09 log10_WOR per million 2.75 r2 0.9671 cum 1,147,849 Sm3; field voidage replacement near 1.0 all years. Use waterflood diagnostics, not pressure depletion alone.

result.summary: bhp_bar reads 0 on 13 days from 2013-07-08 to 2013-07-22 while the well was shut in; the gauge may just be switched off.
30-day median water_cut first goes above 0.05 on 2013-09-06, 1 months after first oil.

oil_rate shifts around 2014-11-23: weekly mean 1,140 -> 524 (-54%) from the period before to the period after; across the change itself, 4 weeks each side, 1,045 -> 411 (-61%); the choke was cut at the same time (11 -> 5%), so part of the change is the operator's, not the reservoir's.

oil_rate shifts around 2015-01-18: weekly mean 524 -> 1,259 (+140%) from the period before to the period after; across the change itself, 4 weeks each side, 437 -> 973 (+122%); the choke was opened at the same time (5 -> 13%), so part of the change is the operator's, not the reservoir's.
water_cut shifts around 2015-07-19: weekly mean 0.187 -> 0.703 (+0.52) from the period before to the period after; across the change itself, 4 weeks each side, 0.36 -> 0.48 (+0.12).
30-day median water_cut first goes above 0.5 on 2015-08-25, 25 months after first oil.

oil_rate shifts around 2016-03-27: weekly mean 1,259 -> 509 (-60%) from the period before to the period after; across the change itself, 4 weeks each side, 858 -> 664 (-23%); the choke stayed about the same (100 -> 100%).
30-day median water_cut first goes above 0.8 on 2016-05-02, 33 months after first oil.

issues.text: oil rate 60% lower in the period after than before (weekly mean 1,259 -> 509 Sm3/d), a gradual change: 23% across it
31 days shut in over the last 180

summaries.summary: Drilled 12 1/4" hole from 2627 m MD to 2787 m MD.
Drilled and orientated 12 1/4" hole from 2787 m to 2917 m. POOH from 2917 m to 368 m to change bit.

POOH with 12 1/4" BHA. L/O mud motor, CoPilot, AutoTrack and 12 1/4" bit. P/U back-up motor, Copilot, AutoTrack and 12 1/4" bit. RIH to 2870 m reamed/washed in hole to 2917 m. Drilled and orientated 12 1/4" hole to 3104 m.
Inflow tested SCSSSV and HMV. R/D wireline equipment and prepared for skidding operations..
Performed pressure testing of valves on F-11 Xmas tree in preparation for handover to production department.
Performed final pressure testing on F-11B tree and handed well over to production.
Lifted wireline equipment off vessel and started to spot same.
Spotted wireline equipment and hooked up same. Leak and function tested BOP. Started to build lubricator sections and GIH.
Completed spotting equipment. Well handed over from production department. Rigged up wireline equipment.
Completed rigging up WL equipment. Leak tested R/U to 20/345 bar. Logged first sigma pass from 4530 m to 3440 m. Started to log first IC pass from 4254 m.
Completed first set of RST IC logging passes from 4254 to 3470 m. Started second set of RST IC logging passes in same intervals.
Completed logging RST IC passes. Performed shut in PLT pass. Started to bean up well for flowing PLT passes.
Logged three flowing PLT passes. Evaluated data and decided to perforate two new zones. POOH and L/D BHA. Started to prepare perforation gun.
M/U BHA #2 Tractor and 4,5" perforating guns. RIH and performed correlation and orientation of the perforation gun.
Perforated zone from 3960-3969 m. POOH and prepared toolstring for next perforation. RIH and started to correlate depth prior to perforate.
Perforated zone from 3910 m to 3919 m. POOH and L/D toolstring. Rigged down equipment and tested XMT barriers. Handed well over to production.
Recieved and spotted equipment
Prepared WL equipment for rig up. Started to shut-in well.
Prepared WL equipment for rig-up. Handover of well. Rigged up WL Equipment
Perforated well. R/D WL equipment
R/D WL equipment
Received well from production. Rigged up WL equipment. Unable to leak test Rig-up.
Waited for repair of grease pump. R/D WL equipment and changed O-rings in X-over. R/U WL equipment.

Tested RU. Opened well and RIH to 2830 m. Tractored down to 3735 mMD. Made multiple correlation passes. Set straddle across interval 3674.4 - 3685 mMD. POOH and L/D BHA. M/U BHA #3 (Straddle-Tractor) and RIH.
Correlated and set straddle. POOH. L/D BHA and R/D WL equipment.
Packed equipment. Cleaned workspace. Demobilized personell.
- Skidded cantilever onto slot F-11 - R/U WL equipment - Attempted to pressure test lower WL riser and WL BOP
- R/U WL pressure control equipment - Bullheaded sea water into the well - RIH w/ deep set barrier plug

- Installed deepset barrier plug. Pressure tested and inflow tested same - Cut 7in tubing above production packer - Instaled shallow set barrier plug. Pressure tested same - Started R/D WL pressure control equipment
- Finished R/D WL - N/D X-tree and spacer spool - N/U HP riser and BOP, performed connector test - R/U casing handling equipment - RIH w/ THRT
- Landed and engaged THRT - Pumped open shallow set barrier plug - Retrieved TH and 500m of tubing - RIH w/ tubing, circulated well clean to sea water
- Placed balanced cement plug in 9 5/8in casing - Pulled and L/D 600m of tubing - RIH w/ tubing on spear, tagged cement - Released spear and left tubing in the well

- POOH w/ spear - Retrieved MS-T seal assy - Cut 10 3/4in tieback casing - RIH w/ spear and pulled 10 3/4in tieback casing - Released and retrieved tieback adapter - Punched below 10 3/4in subsea casing hanger and ventilated annulus - M/U and RIH w/ cutter BHA to cut 9 5/8in casing
- Cut 9 5/8in casing - Milled 10 3/4in subsea casing hanger - Fished 10 3/4in casing fish and secured on surface - Pulled 34 joints of 10 3/4in casing, L/D same

- Finished puling 10 3/4in casing to X-over - Pulled 9 5/8in casing - Installed 14in EZSV (lower) - Cut 14in casing - Punched below 14in subsea casing hanger - Installed 14in EZSV (upper) - Displaced C-annulus to sea water
- WOC, meanwhile performed mantenance on rig equipment - Pressure tested C-annulus cement plug
- Placed balanced cement plug in 14in casing - N/D BOP
- Skidded to well F-11 B - Pulled production riser
None

result.note: Daily reports exist for drilling and for work on the well (wireline, plugs, perforations, production logs), not for days of normal production. A job's date is the day the work was done; kind is drilling, completion, workover (work on a producing or injecting well) or abandonment. Ask for one day to see every operation line.

result.notes: WOR = water/oil by month; the trend is log10(WOR) against cumulative oil, fitted on up to 36 recent months with WOR >= 1. The water cuts in to_limits are reference points, not an economic limit: the data holds no costs or prices, so remaining_oil_sm3 says how much oil is left before each, not whether it pays. field_voidage: replacement_ratio is injection over voidage at reservoir conditions (Bo 1.385 m3/Sm3 from PUD p.20, low/high with Bo 1.5/1.27; Bw 1; above the bubble point, so no free gas); surface_ratio is the same in surface volumes, which overstates replacement.
